files.migration_notes: Global stylesheet. Keep as-is but import into React entry point. No jQuery-specific patterns; only standard CSS. Ensure class names (e.g., .completed, .task-text) match those used in React component.

Convert entire jQuery logic to a single React component (App) with useState for tasks array and showingCompletedOnly flag. Replace DOM manipulation with state updates. Replace $.ajax with fetch in useEffect for initial data load. Event handlers become inline functions updating state. Derive stats from tasks state. Render task list via map. Import styles.css. Also include ReactDOM.createRoot render call in same file (entry point).

for React mount, change script to type="module" src="/src/main.jsx". Adjust asset paths (no PUBLIC_URL). Keep CSS link but update href to "/src/styles.css" (or import via JS).

overall_notes: Migrate to Vite + React 18. Single-component approach due to one-to-one file constraint. Risks: all logic in one file may become unwieldy; state management must replace all jQuery DOM mutations. Ensure fetch error handling. CSS imported via JS to enable HMR. No code splitting allowed; future refactoring can extract components after migration.
